  type      string, one of: worktree, branch
  target    string
  branch    string, absent when empty
            Branch is absent for a bare branch, whose name is already the target.
  reason    string, one of: uncommitted_changes, unpushed_commits,
            no_upstream_with_commits, commits_beyond_merged_pr, local_commits_beyond_pr,
            in_use_by_process
  detail    string
